summary.text: Shea Roberts, a Democrat from Atlanta, represents District 52 in the Georgia House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Georgia Public Broadcasting's 2020 candidate profile says Roberts was born in Dalton, Georgia, is an attorney and realtor, and has been a member of the Georgia Bar since 1996.
It says she and her husband, attorney Brian Daughdrill, are partners in the Buckhead law firm Giacoma Roberts & Daughdrill, LLC.
